text:
emma: Heads-up: nightly CI linkcheck failed on /integrations/aws#AssumeRole -> 404. The heading in the migrated page has an emoji (🔐) and mkdocs slugger is stripping it differently than docusaurus, so legacy links like #AWS.AssumeRole don't resolve. ocean: ugh, emoji in headings was intentional in that section for visual cue. but mkdocs-material removes emoji from slugs and sometimes inserts a transliteration, causing mismatch. priya: hmm. I dug in: heading was `### 🔐 Assume role (cross-account)` and mkdocs produced `assume-role-cross-account` while the old fragments were `AWS.AssumeRole`. Also noticed a stray ZWJ in a copied heading that made a silent different slug on one page only. emma: silent ZWJ? yikes. that explains why only one of the two similar pages broke. can we normalize by adding explicit ids and preserve legacy anchor? e.g. `

🔐 Assume role (cross-account)

` ocean: yes. small PR is safest. also remove emoji from the explicit id to keep ids ascii-friendly. priya: while patching, I can run a quick grep for non-ascii/ZWJ characters in docs/ and flag any headings that contain them. I'll add a tiny check to the docs lint script to warn on those. docsbot: automated note: please include linkcheck output in PR so reviewers can see the failing anchor. emma: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5120 - includes three commits: 1) explicit id + legacy anchor, 2) grep-based cleanup + lint tweak, 3) normalize code fence languages (awscli -> bash). ci-bot: queued checks for PR 5120: linkcheck, markdownlint, unicode-lint, accessibility. priya: pasted failing snippet in PR description: ``` ERROR: /integrations/aws#AWS.AssumeRole -> 404 (anchor not found) ``` ocean: nice. can preview deploy please so we can click through? preview-bot: Netlify deploy requested for branch docs/aws-anchor-compat (build 101222). docsbot: FYI, we added a docs lint rule to `scripts/docs-lint.sh` that warns on headings containing non-ascii punctuation or zero-width joiners. it's non-blocking for now but will be enforced after one week. ci-bot: linkcheck on preview: PASS, markdownlint: PASS, unicode-lint: WARN (found other emoji-headings flagged, see PR comments) emma: i clicked preview: anchor works and legacy fragment resolves. great. priya: i left a comment in PR proposing we avoid emojis in critical headings where external links are common; small style guide note. ocean: agreed. let's keep decorative emoji in TOC-only badges or callouts, not page headers. emma: LGTM, merging once CI green. docsbot: merged, created issue #1345 to run a one-off job to scan historical docs for ZWJ/emoji header quirks and link to PR for follow-up. priya: follow-up: i'll open a tiny RFC in docs repo suggesting a short rule about ascii-only explicit ids and a one-paragraph guideline about preserving legacy anchors when migrating. ocean: thanks team. closing thread. :wave:
